analyses.content: 录音提到他除了作曲和教书，还写了大量的短文（essays），对应题目中的 "written many"。
你需要注意 "produced a large number of" 是 "written many" 的同义替换，听到后立刻抓取后面的名词，不要被后面举例的具体话题干扰。

"Turning to his work, he composed a great deal in the nineteen seventies and was a music teacher until nineteen eighty-two. Apart from composing music and teaching, he has also produced a large number of essays on a range of topics, such as the philosophy behind his work and musical form."
录音里明确说他在2011年获得了一个重要奖项，用来表彰他的音乐独创性（originality）。
你听到数字 "twenty eleven" 后要保持高度集中，答案词就在紧随其后的 "recognized his musical..." 后面，注意单词拼写。

"Throughout his career, he has won numerous prestigious awards, most notably a major prize in twenty eleven, which recognized his musical originality. So you could say that he is one of the most important composers of our times."
录音提到人们听他音乐最先注意到的是频繁使用的无声/安静（silence），对应题目中与 very soft sounds 并列的特征。
题目中的 "Surprisingly" 对应录音里的 "surprised by"，你听到这个定位词后要迅速捕捉紧接着出现的并列核心词。

"Now I'll talk about the characteristics of his music, which some people are a bit surprised by. The first thing that many listeners will notice about Scarino's music is the frequent use of silence. What is also striking about his music is his preference for extremely soft sounds that are sometimes at such a low volume that they can hardly be heard."
听到“violin”后注意力要高度集中，录音里的“associate with”精准替换了卷面的“resemble those found in”，答案nature随之出现。
你可能会听到strange等修饰词就急着下笔，忽略了题目里“resemble（类似于）”的逻辑，导致填入完全不符合语义的干扰词。

The other unusual aspect of his music is that he frequently requires musicians to play their instruments in unconventional ways so that, for example, a violin may end up sounding very strange and creating sounds we generally associate with nature.
录音中的“widely regarded as”直接替换了题目里的“is seen as”，因此后面的名词pioneer就是正确答案。
你可能会在上一句听到composers就被带跑，但它不符合“被看作是……”的单数逻辑和语义，一定要听懂完整句意再写。
Actually, his novel instrumental techniques have often been imitated by other composers.() As a result, he's widely regarded as a pioneer in terms of creating new sounds.
录音把“compares his music to（把他的音乐比作）”同义替换成了“has likened his music to”，后面直接给出了比喻的本体volcano。
你可能会因为录音中将distant（遥远的）后置替换成了“viewed from afar”而犹豫，只要抓住了对比的核心名词，就不会错过这个词。
It may sound strange, but Scarino himself has likened his music to a volcano viewed from afar.() As you'll see, it builds up slowly to an exciting climax.
听到“nineteen seventy-nine”定位后，录音用“dedicated to a friend（献给一位朋友）”对应了题目中的“in memory of a...”，答案就是friend。
你可能会听到后面的memorial就想填进去，但题目空前是“a”，且“in memory of”本身就是纪念的意思，这里需要填被纪念的对象。

Let's move on to talk about the particular piece that we'll hear at the concert.() Many people consider it to be his finest work to date.() It's an immense piece of music for piano, chorus, and orchestra that was completed in nineteen seventy-nine.() The work is dedicated to a friend who died unexpectedly, so it was written as a kind of memorial.
卷面上的“sounds like”被替换成了非常典型的“is similar to”，紧跟着的名词thunder即为正确答案。
你可能会把前面的noise或者sound当作答案，但题目问的是“听起来像什么”，一定不要忽略“like”这个关键的比较信号词。

The piece opens with a low sound of great complexity that is similar to thunder.() This low-pitched noise is sustained almost uninterrupted for forty-five minutes, which may sound quite boring, but I found it to be very haunting and atmospheric.
录音中的“created by”对应题目的“produced by”，“large pieces of”被替换成了“large vibrating sheets of”，最后落脚在材质metal上。
你可能会因为想填sheets或者percussionists而犯错，但题目中有“pieces of”限制了后面应填入一种物质或材料，不要被录音里的倒装句式干扰。
The sound, by the way, is created by large vibrating sheets of metal, which are slowly manipulated by two percussionists.
前半句的Even though对应题目中的although，随后的“conventional”完美替换了卷面的“traditional”，后面紧跟的名词structure就是答案。
你可能会因为没听出conventional和traditional的高频同义替换而跟丢答案，平时一定要多积累这种常见的替换词对。

Even though the piece will be, for many people, very unusual in terms of the sounds it creates, it actually has a very conventional structure, which is just another surprising aspect of Scarino's work.
